name: Tarn Erikstad
location: Underworld B3, near sub-level access near State and Van Buren
carried_weapons: Forge-Smith Collective Ablonite Push Dagger 'Bone Key'

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly East Asian with significant Northern European, Southeast Asian, and Pacific Islander ancestry, creating a striking blend of features. The combination manifests in his bone structure—higher cheekbones and eye shape from East Asian heritage, balanced by Northern European jaw prominence and Pacific Islander robustness. His genetic makeup creates that rare phenotype where continental features converge into something distinctly his own.
physical_description.build: Heavily muscled, broad-shouldered frame running to fat around the midsection—the body of someone who once moved for a living and now mostly sits. Thick neck, powerful forearms.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with grey streaking at the temples
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a loose, greying ponytail; sides shaved close
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm olive-bronze with subtle golden undertones, weathered and sun-damaged despite decades underground. The tone reflects his East Asian-Southeast Asian majority ancestry with Northern European and Pacific Islander undertones creating depth.
physical_description.complexion: Strong, wide-set face with higher cheekbones characteristic of East Asian heritage, tempered by broader structure from Pacific Islander ancestry. Heavy jaw shows both Northern European and Southeast Asian influence. Deep laugh lines around the eyes. Three-day stubble habit. Small scar through the left eyebrow from an old blade cut.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. His hands show no chrome, his eyes are unremarkable. Any modifications are subcutaneous or so old they've integrated into flesh.
distinguishing_marks: Burn scar across the back of his right hand, extending up the wrist—pale and shiny, webbed pattern suggesting thermal damage from a circuit fire or plasma discharge.
Crude prison-style tattoo on his left forearm: interlinked rings in faded blue ink, Bore Rats faction mark from his early career.
Long horizontal scar across his left ribs, visible when he moves without a shirt—testament to a stabbing wound that nearly took him out twenty years ago.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate weight, economical gestures. Sits heavy in a chair. When standing, shoulders slightly rolled forward. Speaks with his hands less than he listens with them—a fixer's caution. Walks with a faint limp in the left leg from an old injury.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 utilitarian: worn synth-leather jacket in charcoal, unbranded but quality. Loose linen shirt underneath, cream-coloured, collar always unbuttoned. Dark cargo pants with multiple pockets and zip-offs, practical and worn. Steel-toed boots, scuffed. A simple silver chain around his neck with a data chip pendant—encrypted, never accessed in public. No flash, no logos. Clothes smell faintly of diesel and static.
